title: Ball Lightning Skill Guide: Bolt Frequency, Fire Infusion and Shock
summary: Ball Lightning launches a slow projectile that does not hit directly but discharges lightning bolts every 0.2 seconds at nearby enemies.

seo.title: Ball Lightning Skill Guide: Bolts and Infusion (PoE2 0.5)
seo.description: How Ball Lightning works in PoE2 0.5: 0.2-second bolts, shock scaling, Fire Infusion, projectile speed, supports and builds.

sections.title: Quick answer
paragraphs: Fire the slow orb through or beside a target so its repeated bolts remain in range as long as possible. The orb itself does not hit; the nearby lightning discharges do.
Projectile speed is a tuning stat: slower travel can add time near a boss, while faster travel improves reach and mapping comfort.

properties.label: Cast time
notes: Can be used while moving with the skill's movement penalty.

properties.label: Bolt interval
notes: An enemy in range can be targeted repeatedly as the orb travels.

properties.label: Target radius
notes: Quality can increase the targeting radius.

properties.label: Projectile speed
notes: Quality can reduce speed; projectile-speed modifiers change contact time.

properties.label: Fire Infusion
notes: Creates ignited ground and an end explosion in addition to the lightning behaviour.

sections.title: Requirements and setup
bullets: Needs Intelligence and enough mana for a sustained or repeated cast pattern.
Single-target performance depends on placing a slow path close to the boss.
Fire-Infused scaling is a separate branch; do not assume lightning supports improve the fire explosion or ignited ground.

sections.title: Core mechanics
paragraphs: Ball Lightning passes through enemies without the ball itself dealing a hit. Its bolts select enemies within the listed radius every 0.2 seconds, which makes travel path and speed central to real damage.

A large target or a target moving beside the projectile can remain in range for several discharges. Additional projectiles improve coverage, but they do not guarantee that every orb will repeatedly target the same enemy.

When a Fire Infusion is consumed, the projectile slows over time, lays ignited ground, and explodes after dissipating. That fire package has its own critical chance and damage values and should be treated as a deliberate hybrid choice.

sections.title: What scales each component
rows: More time near a stationary boss
Shorter reach and slower map coverage
Fewer possible bolt intervals near one target
Does not increase bolt frequency by itself
May spread away from a single target
Ignited ground and final fire explosion
Requires fire scaling and reliable infusion generation

supports.label: Considered Casting
notes: Strong self-cast damage when the cast-speed loss remains comfortable.

supports.label: Magnified Area
notes: Increases practical target coverage around each orb.

supports.label: Lightning Attunement
notes: Favours the pure lightning version while reducing other elements.

supports.label: Projectile Acceleration
notes: Mapping option; faster travel can reduce boss contact time.

supports.label: Multishot
notes: Adds coverage but carries speed and damage tradeoffs that must be tested.

sections.title: Support compatibility rules
paragraphs: Choose supports for the component that actually deals damage in the build. A support can be technically compatible while weakening placement, speed, conversion, or another component.
bullets: Re-test projectile speed, duration, and area after changing supports.
Do not infer support behaviour from the visual effect alone.
Keep one flexible socket for mapping or bossing needs.

sections.title: Mapping rotation
paragraphs: Cast across the pack's movement line rather than directly at its front edge. One well-angled orb can keep discharging while the character moves to the next group.
Use faster projectiles or additional projectiles only when coverage is the bottleneck. If normal enemies already die, spend sockets on mana comfort or a boss-specific link.

sections.title: Bossing rotation
paragraphs: Aim so the projectile travels through the boss's centre line or along its movement. Recast after it leaves the targeting radius, not simply whenever the cast animation is available.
Against a stationary target, slower projectile speed and controlled casting can outperform frantic spam because more bolts remain eligible to fire.

sections.title: Build use cases
bullets: Lightning self-cast builds that scale repeated hits and shock.
Trigger or utility setups that need a sustained projectile in an area.
Hybrid Fire Infusion builds prepared to scale the explosion and ground effect separately.

steps.label: Boss damage is lower than mapping damage
steps.action: Slow or redirect the projectile so the boss stays within 1.8 metres.

steps.label: The skill consumes too much mana
steps.action: Use fewer deliberate casts and add cost efficiency.
steps.result: Remove a support whose multiplier is not improving the intended component.

steps.label: Fire Infusion feels weak
steps.action: Separate the lightning, explosion, and ignited-ground scaling.
steps.result: Confirm the build can generate the infusion often enough to justify the sockets.

sections.title: Common mistakes
bullets: Assuming the visible orb hits enemies.
Stacking projectile speed for bosses without checking lost contact time.
Expecting additional projectiles to shotgun one target automatically.
Using a Fire Infusion without any fire or ignite plan.

items.question: Does the ball itself hit?
answer: No. Nearby bolts are the damaging lightning hits.

items.question: Is slower projectile speed always better?
answer: No. It helps stationary single targets but can make mapping and target acquisition worse.

items.question: Can one enemy be hit repeatedly?
answer: Yes, while it remains inside the bolt targeting radius across multiple 0.2-second intervals.

items.question: Does area increase bolt frequency?
answer: No. It improves coverage; the listed interval remains the same.

items.question: Should every build use Fire Infusion?
answer: Only builds that can generate it and scale the added fire package without weakening their core lightning plan.
